create_Co3d_Multiview_dataset: create a Co3d_Multiview dataset instance with 4 views and a specified ROOT path for training
generate_combinations_multiview: generate view combinations within a degree range for multiview sampling across 100 images
fetch_views_for_pool: fetch valid views from an image pool with oversampling when insufficient views are available
load_view_data: load a single view including RGB image, depthmap, camera pose, and intrinsics from disk
get_views_with_retry: get multiview data with automatic retry logic across different scenes on failure
